A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 32-page versions of HoneyBee: Data Recipes for Vision-Language Reasoners. Text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–F support reliable comparison. Pages 17–32, including all appendices, render identically.

before.justification: v1 reports original data-curation, model-training, scaling and inference experiments in Section 5, with additional filtering, intervention and teacher self-improvement results in Appendices A–C.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and outcomes, including PLM benchmark results, RL training, shared-caption decoding and the appendix experiments.

M1.justification: The context-curation pipeline, data interventions, scaling procedures, training objectives and shared-caption inference method are unchanged. The appendix configurations and generation prompts also match.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six context sources, OpenThoughts3 text-only augmentation, ten final evaluation benchmarks and verified multimodal RL data. No datasets, tasks, domains or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within corresponding experiments: PLM, InternVL and Qwen2.5-VL models in Table 1; training datasets in Figure 1b; OpenVLThinker-v1.2-3B in Table 6; and the base teacher in Appendix C.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D retain the same preprocessing, splits, sample counts, metrics, model sizes and training settings. Five-epoch SFT, greedy evaluation with a 2,048-token cap, and the separate RL and test-time-scaling protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The source/filtering comparisons, intervention ablations, data-scaling studies, MathVision difficulty analysis, model-size correlation analysis and caption-sharing comparison are retained. Appendices A–C and F contain the same supplementary experiments and qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point accuracies, averages across tasks/model sizes and correlation coefficients. Neither introduces repeated-seed information, uncertainty intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted trends and qualitative findings match after aligning relocated displays. For example, Table 1 retains PLM-HoneyBee average accuracies of 36.2, 46.2 and 49.8 for the 1B, 3B and 8B models. Appendix results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The dataset and CoT definitions, SFT objective, intervention/scaling formulas and shared-caption token-cost reasoning are unchanged. No formal assumptions, proofs or derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: the HoneyBee dataset, findings about context selection and interventions, scaling benefits, competitive reasoning performance and the claimed 73% decoding-cost reduction.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning source mixing, effective interventions, cross-modal transfer and correlations across model sizes are unchanged. Both retain the same single-image scope and future-work qualifications, along with appendix explanations for unsuccessful augmentations.

D1.justification: v2 adds a first-page Code link identifying the facebookresearch/HoneyBee_VLM repository, absent from v1. Existing implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware information, prompts and third-party code references remain unchanged. This adds access information without documenting a procedural change.

R1.justification: Section 6 retains the same positioning relative to earlier CoT datasets, VL reasoning and data-curation research. The 83-item reference list is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 corrects the author name from Devandra Singh Sachan to Devendra Singh Sachan and updates the date/version text. The scientific prose, terminology, section sequence and appendix wording remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from page 1 to page 2, Table 1 moves from page 2 to page 3, and the introduction starts on page 1 instead of page 2. Subsequent text and embedded displays reflow, while display content, captions and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new first-page project-code reference supplies useful implementation-access information absent from v1, and the author-name correction improves attribution. Scientific content and appendix evidence are preserved, while layout changes have limited impact. The improvement is confined to documentation; the PDFs do not establish the linked repository's completeness or usability.
